Uses of Interface
io.webagent4j.verification.IVerification

Packages that use IVerification
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.action
Verified browser actions: one explicit, bounded command pipeline per interaction, with three terminal modes - real execution, dryRun(), and plan() - that all share the exact same target-resolution and precondition logic so they can never disagree.
io.webagent4j.verification
Deterministic, side-effect-free, pollable conditions over current page state - used both as action postconditions (IPreparedAction#expect(...)) and standalone.

    List<VerificationResult>
    VerificationEngine.awaitAll(IVerificationContext context, List<? extends IVerification> verifications, WaitBudget budget, Duration interval)
    Evaluates all conditions in encounter order, passing the exact same WaitBudget instance to every one of them - no per-condition conversion to a remaining Duration and back into a new budget - so they share one shrinking deadline instead of each independently receiving a full, fresh timeout.

    VerificationEngine.awaitAll(IVerificationContext context, List<? extends IVerification> verifications, Duration timeout, Duration interval)
